reviews.review: I luckily got in before the game became dead, it was a lot of fun while it lasted. I love Alien so this game was right up my alley. Recommend getting it on sale.

Always ignore "Steam Curators" 99% of them dribble from their mouths as they "review" things.

Anyway

The game itself is fine, it keeps you moving, there are 'main stage' type events where you get time to set up your turrets, mines etc. Nice mix of alien types. The story missions are mostly the same scenarios; go in, go to point X, restock, set up, clear waves, move on to the next X and repeat 2 or 3 times.

The other game modes are fun, BUT, the community is completely dead. You'll spend more time in matchmaking queues than you ever will in a mission/game mode.

Unless you have a group of friends you can always join up with, I wouldn't bother, unless you want to play alone with absolutely awful bots. This game was clearly abandoned, which is a shame because it could have been much more. 

I wouldn't buy unless it's heavily discounted, and if you do buy, be prepared to playing solo, there is no community, the game is dead.

The game is awesome and really fun to play with friends. Some really cool level design and atmosphere. Not very story driven other than loads of passive dialog. Good graphics and cool sound effects. I liked the voice acting and some of the chit chat is pretty funny too. Mostly action based with tons of character customization. I wouldn't worry too much about getting all the different DLC content. Although I think the Pathogen expansion is worth a buy. I managed to get a package deal on sale and it was worth it. I do wish there were a few more maps but most alien fans will find enjoyment from this game.

Buy it on sale guys.  The game is SHORT.  I mean 6-8 hours of gameplay.   It is quite fun with friends, but I'd only recommend if you have a few friends to play with because the bots are straight trash.  If you don't mind replaying levels and you have friends this game is pretty fun.  I doubt I'll crest 50 hours in this game, but for 9 bucks it was well worth it.
